q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Xiaoyu. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. I live with my parents and my grandmother. I find English the easiest subject at school, because I practise it every day and I like talking to people. I usually listen to pop music, and sometimes Chinese traditional music with my grandmother. I like cats best, because they’re quiet and very cute. Yes, I like shopping, especially for books and clothes with my friends. I take photos about three times a week, usually of my friends, food and beautiful places. I like science-fiction films, because they’re exciting and full of new ideas. I usually meet my friends in a café near my home, because it’s quiet and we can chat there. Yes, I enjoy playing games on my phone, but only at the weekend, because I’m busy with homework on weekdays.

互动交流：能回应对方、提出和回应建议与观点，推动讨论并努力达成一致
整体表现：能用 B1 水平的语言有效完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子作答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, especially…），能用一般现在时、频率副词和 like/enjoy doing 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see a family in their living room. There are five people sitting on a big sofa, and I think they’re watching a film on the television. The TV is on the wall on the right. In the front there’s a woman and a young girl, and they’re eating popcorn from a yellow box. Next to them there’s a man with glasses, and an older man, maybe the grandfather. In the middle of the room there’s a small black table and a black-and-white rug. Behind them there’s a big window, a bookcase with lots of books and some green plants. It looks like an afternoon at the weekend. I think they’re relaxing and having a nice time together.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要说清人物在做什么、在哪里，以及房间里的物品，用 on the right / in the front / next to / behind 等方位词组织，并用 I think / maybe / It looks like 合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. A party room is great for a big group, and we can have music and decorations. A barbecue is fun too, but you’re right, the garden may be too small for thirty students. I think the restaurant is a bit boring, and it’s expensive. The swimming pool sounds exciting, but some students can’t swim. A picnic is cheap and there’s lots of space in the park, but the weather can be a problem. In my opinion, the party room is the best, because everyone can come, it doesn’t matter if it rains, and we can dance and play games. So shall we choose the party room? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），从人数、天气、费用等方面比较不同地方的优缺点，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最适合一大群人的地方。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I did. I invited five friends to my home and my mum made a big cake, because I wanted a small, relaxed party. I went to my cousin’s birthday party last month. It was at a restaurant and there were a lot of people. I enjoy the games most, because everyone laughs and has fun together. My favourite day of the year is Spring Festival, because my whole family gets together and we eat lots of delicious food. I think it’s important to have special days, because they give us a break from school and work, and we can spend time with the people we love.
